title: Airport-Rider Upgrade Discount (Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly)
content:
# Airport-rider upgrade discount

*Wayfare Pass (rider membership), on a move up to Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly.*

**Definition.** The airport-rider upgrade discount counts the member's completed trips dropped off in the last three months that picked up or dropped off at an airport: 3 percent at 3 or more, 1 percent at 1 or 2, nothing at none.

**Airport trip.** A trip in the member's trip records in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) whose airport leg is the pickup or the drop-off, whose status is completed and whose drop-off falls in the last three months. Any ride option counts. A trip with no airport leg is not counted.

**Effect.** The discount is taken off the Plus Monthly upgrade charge as that percentage of the Plus Monthly membership fee of 19.99; the percentage is of the 19.99 fee itself, the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

| Completed airport trips dropped off in the last three months | Discount |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 3 percent |
| 1 or 2 | 1 percent |
| none | nothing |

**Examples (hypothetical).** One airport pickup and two airport drop-offs, all completed in the last three months: 3 trips, 3 percent, so 0.5997 is taken off. A single completed airport drop-off: 1 percent, 0.1999 taken off. An airport trip dropped off four months ago is outside the count.
